title: ‘Stranger Things: Tales From ’85’ Renewed for Season 2 at Netflix — Showrunner Eric Nobles Teases What’s Ahead (Exclusive)
summary: The hit spinoff set between seasons two and three of 'Stranger Things' proper nabs a major win for animation: "This community needs a lot of love and support, so the importance of what just happened was huge," says Nobles of 'Tales From '85' success.
